description: The plot illustrates mean interclass similarity values across relation categories for three conditions, with additional horizontal dashed lines indicating average similarity for two of the conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Relation Category,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer categories from 0 to about 65 with tick labels shown at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60. The y-axis is labeled “Mean Interclass Similarity,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 0.5 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.1 intervals. Three solid lines with small point markers are shown: a blue line with circular markers labeled “w/o DPO obo,” an orange line with circular markers labeled “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” and a green line with circular markers labeled “DPO.” The blue series fluctuates across categories, starting near ~0.22 at category 0, reaching a prominent early peak near ~0.48 around category 1, and then varying mostly between roughly ~0.03 and ~0.27 through the mid-range, with another high point near ~0.48 around category 31, and ending near ~0.02 at the final category. The orange series also fluctuates, starting near ~0.16 at category 0, showing multiple spikes including values around ~0.39 near category ~16, around ~0.46 near category ~31, around ~0.43 near category ~33, and a late spike near ~0.46 around category ~60, and it ends near ~0.07–0.08 at the final category. The green series stays comparatively lower and smoother, starting near ~0.19 at category 0, dipping to around ~0.03–0.06 in the early categories, then oscillating mostly between ~0.05 and ~0.17 across the plot, and ending near ~0.07–0.08. Two dashed horizontal reference lines indicate averages: a blue dashed line labeled “Average of w/o DPO obo” at approximately 0.107 (also annotated “0.107” near the left), and an orange dashed line labeled “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” at approximately 0.158 (annotated “0.158”); an additional green numeric annotation “0.086” appears near the left aligned with the green series level.
